name: Returned-draft review resubmission recovery
scope: Replace stale review submission evidence when a returned draft is resubmitted
Reload authoritative contract state after workflow response failures
Restore approval controls when a transition committed before an error response

dataIsolation.guard: The package contains generic transition logic only; tenant-local contract evidence is not copied.

definitionOfDone: A returned draft can be resubmitted without stale timestamp mismatch
The newest review timestamp and actor are authoritative
The workspace recovers its visible state after a committed transition response error
Approval controls are visible for the authoritative internal-review state
